queries.name: ListProductLines
queries.order: name casefolded for presentation then product_line_id

queries.name: ListContractProductLines
queries.returns: CPL plus owning Contract Customer and current policy revision summary

queries.name: GetPolicyHistory
queries.returns: immutable policy revisions and exact tiers

queries.name: PreviewSrClassification
queries.returns: ELIGIBLE|UNRESOLVED|INCOMPATIBLE|AMBIGUOUS|STALE plus exact SR/Customer/CPL/policy/mapping input fingerprint and bounded candidates
rules: reads current SlaInput and resolved Customer
automatic result is eligible only when exactly one active Customer-compatible mapping applies
no command receipt, classification event, current-classification mutation or audit event is created

queries.name: PreviewBatchClassification
queries.returns: every selected target partitioned eligible|incompatible|stale|unresolved|individual_review with exact per-target base token and batch fingerprint/totals
rules: delegates each member eligibility to PreviewSrClassification semantics
no selected SR is silently skipped

queries.name: GetSrClassification
queries.returns: current valid CPL or unclassified plus resolved Customer compatibility/current policy

queries.name: GetIndividualSla
queries.returns: classification/calculation states, exact elapsed rational, per-tier individual results and warning inputs

queries.name: ListCanonicalCohorts
queries.returns: exact cohort count + page; zero-denominator cohort keys are not fabricated

queries.name: GetCohortMembers
queries.returns: exact canonical CohortProjectionV1 for the requested key/as_of plus one bounded service_request_id-ordered member page, member exact total and continuation
rules: member paging never changes denominator/state authority
America/Guayaquil defines the canonical cohort period
zero-denominator nonexistent cohort key is not fabricated

queries.name: ListSlaWarnings
queries.returns: derived conditions only; no warning row is lifecycle authority

index_rules: Report-Date month candidate selection uses accepted source projection indexes owned by LLD-03/04 and Customer/CPL classification index
CPL/Contract Customer compatibility is joined by immutable ids, never labels
policy tiers are loaded by current policy revision + severity with bounded tier count
pagination is deterministic and exact totals are not inferred from loaded page size
privacy_rule: List/drilldown queries expose only fields needed by the requested SLA/catalog view and never retrieve full source observations, Communications bodies or Working Notes.
